title: B14 material and constitutive transfer of the one-day LARE groundwater frontier
scientific_question: Does the one-day fixed-water-table groundwater-response state requirement demonstrated on B01 transfer to B14, and does layer placement rather than state count become the controlling representation choice?

authority.choice_rationale: Material transfer directly tests representation generality while avoiding new groundwater-coupling or lower-boundary semantics.

rom1x1.implication: B14 cannot be described as a new blind material.

dyn0a_mech2b.implication: B14 constitutive/dynamic behavior has already been exposed in an earlier fixed-flux LARE mechanism study.

prior_B14_exposure.current_C4X_response_status: The fixed-water-table one-day X01-X04 responses, scaled histories, transferred ladder and placement-control outcomes have not been generated or inspected before this corrected preregistration.

physical_workload.bottom_boundary: zero pressure head at fixed 160-cm laboratory lower boundary

initial_state_transfer.transfer_invariant: Preserve the absolute height of the deepest active j=101 front for each C4R/C4V history.
initial_state_transfer.formula: lambda_B14=lambda_B01*psi_B01(Se=0.505)/psi_B14(Se=0.505), using the frozen material retention curves.

LARE.closure: BC1 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE with B14 constitutive parameters only
LARE.initial_projection: exact conservative integration of the B14 finite-water-content profile onto each fixed partition

R2.accepted_trajectory_policy: C4R/C4V D13 mode-5 strict accepted-trajectory policy with B14 constitutive parameters

FMC_SMVE.equations: Exact D13 groundwater-front equations with B14 constitutive constants and the prospectively scaled X01-X04 history lambdas.

fine_reference.role: bounded scientific reference for C4X only

components: absolute pooled mean signed terminal-bottom-flux error
maximum absolute final cumulative-bottom-exchange error across histories
groundwater_vector.crossing: componentwise no-worse within 1e-12 numerical equality tolerance
groundwater_vector.profile_diagnostic: mapped 10-cm R16-cell theta RMSE reported separately and added only for PROFILE frontier at day 1.024

H_R8_MATERIAL_TRANSFER.prior: B01 C4V minimum persistent transferred-ladder dimension is R8.
H_R8_MATERIAL_TRANSFER.test: Report whether R8 remains the minimum transferred-ladder member persistently crossing both R2 and FMC on B14.

H_LAYER_PLACEMENT_MATTERS.prior: Earlier state-information work retained P4_TOP_LOWER and U4/U8 as frozen placement controls.
H_LAYER_PLACEMENT_MATTERS.test: At fixed dimension, compare persistence and every vector component for R4 vs P4_TOP_LOWER vs U4, and R8 vs U8. Do not collapse to a scalar ranking.

H_PROFILE_REQUIRES_MORE_STATE.test: At day 1.024 report the minimum reduced member crossing each comparator when mapped-theta RMSE is added to the groundwater vector.

decision_logic.C4X_B14_GW_TRANSFER_FRONTIER_PRESENT: All hard gates pass and at least one reduced LARE representation persistently crosses both R2 and FMC.
decision_logic.C4X_B14_R2_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_ONLY: All hard gates pass; at least one reduced LARE representation persistently crosses R2 but none persistently crosses FMC.
decision_logic.C4X_B14_REDUCED_GW_FRONTIER_NOT_PRESERVE: All hard gates pass but no reduced LARE representation persistently crosses R2.
decision_logic.C4X_FMC_B14_DOMAIN_BLOCKED_BEFORE_REFERE: The pre-Reference FMC B14 domain gate fails; no C4X Reference response may be generated.
decision_logic.C4X_REFERENCE_OR_REPRESENTATION_BLOCKED: Any other Reference, integrity or fail-closed gate fails.

interpretation_boundaries: C4X is prospective and response-blind for the new fixed-water-table X01-X04 workload, but B14 itself is previously exposed and C4X must not be called an independent blind-material confirmation.
Material transfer is not application acceptance.
B14 is one additional material, not cross-material generality.
The fixed zero-head bottom boundary remains laboratory semantics, not coupled-groundwater authority.
Failure of the B01 lower-zone ladder does not authorize post-hoc layer-boundary optimization; only the preregistered P4/U4/U8 controls may be interpreted.
No timing, speedup or production decision is performed in C4X.
No threshold is chosen after inspecting B14 responses.
next_if_positive: Preserve material-dependent minimum state and placement evidence; application acceptance remains blocked pending external H_app/A_temporal.
next_if_negative: Return to representation selection or restrict material domain without retuning C4X.

governance_correction.reason: B14 was previously exposed by ROM1X and DYN0A-MECH2B. The original label 'blind_transfer_B14' overstated independence. This correction changes only the evidentiary label, not histories, material parameters, state scaling, partitions, comparators, metrics, hard gates or decision logic.

allowed_changes: history front-scale mapping -> prospectively scaled X01-X04
addition of frozen placement controls and material-transfer aggregation
